items.author: jxnlco
items.text:
i wanted to learn trumpet, and i really love chet baker.

so i asked codex to find transcriptions of his solos.

that turned into a much bigger project than i expected.

it searched musicians’ websites and academic jazz archives, found legitimate sheet music and midi files, verified which recordings actually contained trumpet solos, and converted everything into notation for b♭ trumpet.

one midi had more than 2,000 guitar notes. codex identified the actual trumpet part instead.

for solos that were only visible in publicly available videos, it reconstructed the notation and credited the original arrangers.

then i kept asking for things:

show me the valve fingerings.
let me change the key and tempo.
explain scales like i’m a beginner.
give me an actual learning path.
loop the hard parts.
add walking bass and backing tracks.
build me a 10-minute practice session.

now i have a personal chet baker practice app with ten playable pieces, guided lessons, phrase looping, and three different backing bands.

宋宋推荐了十个好用的 skill，省流版如下：

1. SkillSpector：本地扫描AI技能仓库/文件，检测提示词注入、数据外泄、权限提升等68种漏洞模式。  
2. AgentSeal：免费本地扫描已装服务的配置与数据流，识别明文密钥、版本风险及组合出的远程执行隐患。  
3. Semia：静态分析技能能做什么并定位越界行为（带行号证据），还能一键自动修复问题代码。  
4. last30days：一次拉取某话题在Reddit、X、YouTube、TikTok等平台最近30天的真实讨论与数据。  
5. humanizer：把AI写作中的33种常见痕迹（拔高、套话、破折号滥用等）逐条去掉，二次重写且不编造事实。  
6. taste-skill：给AI生成的网页/界面注入排版、字体、留白、动效和风格变体，让界面不再像模板货。  
7. Dashi PPT：锁定模板只换文案，快速生成12套主题、上千页组件的稳定PPT，支持HTML/PDF/可编辑PPTX导出。  
8. workbuddy-xhs-skills：按小红书冷启动真实顺序串起10个技能，从“变现倒推”到低粉爆款内容全流程。  
9. ecommerce-visual-copywriting-skill：先出视觉策略与分镜脚本确认方向，再生成主图/详情页文案、设计规格、出图提示词并做合规审查。  
10. voicebox：完全本地运行的声音克隆与多轨编辑工具，支持热键语音输入，并可让智能体用你的声音说话。

VISUAL OS 012 — Acid Session Bulletins

One flyer system. Four sessions, one 24-hour clock.

06:40 — TIDAL PULL CLUB / harbor line / open water
20:45 — ROLL LATE LOOP / plaza circuit / open wheels
21:15 — BANK TURN LATE / east track / two-wheel session
22:30 — FLOOR / SIGNAL / NIGHT / lower hall / one round more

Locked:
– every photo graded to a single electric blue, motion blur kept in
– acid-green ultra-condensed caps, edge to edge, top of frame
– the same face again at the bottom: time + place, oversized, cropped
– white serif italic block dead center — the human voice in the machine
– exactly one orange marker gesture, hand-drawn, over that block
– small italic caps metadata in three columns, hairlines or pill outlines
– the subject always sandwiched between headline and time slab

Swaps: session / three-word headline / time+place code / marker gesture / metadata trio

Same city, same day. Four different reasons to show up.

items.text:
爽了！打死我都不敢信，有公司愿意把这种东西开源！

AI 视频圈最没用的就是“只放成片”，但 Higgsfield 把 95 分钟的 AI 长片《Hell Grind》完全开源了，每条提示词、每份素材，全部公开。

这部片子成本 50 万美元，上过戛纳电影市场，几乎看不出 AI 感，说是实拍我都信。

我翻了一圈，做 AI 视频一定要把这几条都用到自己的工作流里：
1、prompt 别写短句碎片，人家平均一条 3000 个词，等于把分镜脚本直接写成 prompt

2、画面发飘就把物理规则写进提示词：遵守重力和惯性、不要漂浮的道具，一条条明确写

3、去 AI 感靠自然光描述，专门压那种过亮过假的质感

4、复杂动作戏先生成一张俯视地图，再逐个机位写 prompt，镜头才不乱

5、心态放平：视频前 25 分钟是从 16181 次生成里筛出来的 253 个镜头，64 抽 1，就算是专业团队要靠抽卡

这就是最好的学习“AI 视频”的方法，真建议每个做内容的人都去研究一遍，冲！！！

items.text:
平时拿 Codex、Claude Code 做网页自动化的，想必都踩过一堆很折磨人的坑。  

用 Playwright 那套老方案，就得单独再跑一套浏览器实例。

Cookie、登录会话、插件配置全部带不过来，每次都要重新登录一遍。

更烦的是AI和你抢标签页，两边操作互相干扰，干活特别闹心。  

ego‑lite换了一套完全不一样的思路：人和AI共用同一个浏览器。

Agent拥有独立Space隔离工作区，可以同时跑多项任务，通过JS调用执行复杂操作，部分场景速度最高提升2.5倍，还能省下不少Token开销。

Codex、Claude Code、Cursor都可以对接上。  

目前仅支持Mac版本，Windows与Linux还在开发排期。经常要操作后台、CRM、各类社交平台，需要保留登录状态的，这个工具会很适配。 

 🔗https://t.co/Fx79QBM0aq

items.author: AnthropicAI
items.text:
The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. The models attempted to complete an assignment in a setup where their normal safeguards were removed and they were deliberately given internet access. AISI reports that the models “engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations”.

We’re grateful to AISI for their leadership in the important discussion about how to evaluate increasingly capable AI agents. We’re working closely with them to gather more details of the incident as we conduct our own investigation. Gaining a clear picture of Claude’s understanding of its situation—by examining its reasoning transcripts and running our own analyses—will help us identify the causes of its behavior.

The prompts in the evaluation did not impose any specific restrictions on how the internet should be used. This and the removal of safeguards meant that the models were tested under “deliberately permissive conditions” that are not representative of any of our production models. Note that there was no evidence here of an escape from a secure environment.

AISI’s disclosure of the incident can be found here: https://t.co/cJ3hCBtBU7

items.title: Kimi K3 与 Qwen 3.8 逼近闭源顶流，开源性价比优势凸显
items.summary: 帖文称 Kimi K3 与 Qwen 3.8 已贴近闭源顶流榜单，且 Qwen 在八成以上任务上仍是最便宜选项，并据此宣称开源 AI 已优于 Gemini、Grok 等。属强主张型对比，需对照具体榜单截图核验。
items.recommend_reason: 把本场窗口内开源模型“性价比+榜单位次”的高声量主张钉死，便于后续对照 Arena/排行榜原图。

items.author: higgsfield
items.text:
Our 95-minute AI feature film, Hell Grind, is now fully open-sourced for the Higgsfield Global Film Festival. 

All the prompts and assets are public.

It was made for $500,000, screened in Cannes Market, and drew coverage from The Wall Street Journal, Variety, and BBC News. https://t.co/ZC8FvrRjhn
items.title: Higgsfield 开源 95 分钟 AI 长片 Hell Grind 的全部提示词与资产
items.summary: Higgsfield 将 95 分钟 AI 长片 Hell Grind 的提示词与资产全量开源，用于 Global Film Festival；称制作成本约 50 万美元，曾在戛纳市场放映，并获 WSJ、Variety、BBC 报道。
items.recommend_reason: 少见的“完整 AI 长片资产包”开源，可直接研究长片生产流水线，而不只是短视频 demo。

items.author: jinchenma_ai
items.text:
腾讯混元发布了新的语音识别模型 Hy ASR 3.0 preview。

这个模型可以结合上下文纠错、注入热词，也能处理高噪声和耳语场景。

在开源评测集里，中文普通话 WER 3.34%，英语 2.62%，粤语 3.12%。

目前腾讯云 API 已上线，元宝 App 也已首发免费开放。 https://t.co/E7uYUPRwCp
